purpose: Diagnostic binary source qualification per public axis, not answer grounding F1 and not a gate relaxation

axes.v17: predict positive iff observed v17_requested_relation is true; legal different_relation/relation_absent/unresolved are negative
axes.v30: predict positive iff observed v30_relevant is true; legal ambiguous/irrelevant are negative

precision: TP/(TP+FP), null with reason no_predicted_positives if denominator0
recall: TP/(TP+FN), null with reason no_gold_positives if denominator0
F1: 2TP/(2TP+FP+FN); null if denominator0. With gold positives but no predicted positives, F1=0. Exact numerator/denominator recorded.
ops_missing: Primary metrics require all60 valid scored cases with no operational errors/incomplete. Otherwise primary counts/ratios unavailable and any observed valid cohort counts are separately diagnostic; missing/suppressed is not TN or correct withholding.
unsafe: Each axis FP count separately; no downstream false answer claim inferred
joint_gate: Unchanged inherited scorer and full60/60 joint pass with operational completeness required. No F1 threshold, #542 threshold, partial credit or post-output relaxation substitutes.
calculation: Read saved first-results/first-summary once after inherited scorer runs once; no Engine/scorer retry or original rescore. New axis-metrics.json is a separate precommitted diagnostic.
